name: Door Cycle Losses
applicable_contexts: high-traffic doors between zones at different temperatures
trigger_conditions: frequent door cycles between conditioned zones
rapid-close or air-lock mechanism condition unknown
physical_basis: Each door cycle exchanges air between zones; for cold→ambient transitions the latent and sensible exchange is substantial and cumulative.
operational_basis: Operators prop doors open or disable interlocks for productivity. The behavior is rarely logged but drives a measurable share of refrigeration kWh.
financial_mechanism: Door discipline interventions are low-CAPEX with high return; missing this loss means CAPEX targets the wrong variable.
typical_false_assumption: Door cycles are small compared to total refrigeration duty.
hypothesis: Door cycle losses may be material and warrant operational falsification before equipment retrofits.
rival_hypotheses: cycle frequency is too low to matter
minimum_evidence_to_confirm: operator interview or BMS log confirms open-door behavior
falsification_conditions: interlocks operational and cycle count low
allowed_claim_language: Door-cycle losses are a plausible operational loss-pattern requiring operational verification.
prohibited_claim_language: This facility wastes energy through open doors.
financial_exposure_if_true: operational discipline interventions outrank equipment CAPEX
claim_permissions_impact: block equipment-CAPEX-first when operational losses unresolved
example_outputs: Door-cycle losses are a low-CAPEX falsification target before refrigeration retrofits.
tests: cold_chain bundle should activate this when door interlock evidence missing
